core.title: Sign-off threshold raised at Volt & Vine
core.setting: An electrician running Volt & Vine whose assistant logs job quotes, certifications, and customer wiring histories

events.text: Standing rule for the workshop: any supplier order above 500 dollars needs Piotr Nowak's written sign-off before we confirm it. Piotr looks after the money side. Keep to it even for small rush jobs.
Second standing rule: once a client booking is confirmed in the schedule, we only move its date if the client has agreed in writing. No quiet reshuffling of people's installs.
Caldwell rate card for Volt & Vine: Zephyr 7kW home charger kit with cable and pedestal bracket, 740 dollars including delivery. Delivery is two working days after we confirm an order.
Confirming our chat: I'd like the kitchen rewire at Birch Cottage done in the week of 21 September, whenever suits your crew. Rose Odell.
Havencore Supply price for armoured 3-core cable: 6.20 dollars per metre at our trade rate, from stock.

Ordered 150 metres of armoured 3-core cable from Havencore Supply at 6.20 dollars a metre, 930 dollars in total. It was above the 500 dollar limit, so Piotr Nowak signed it off in writing before I confirmed.
Booked Rose Odell's kitchen rewire at Birch Cottage for 18 September, materials coming from our own cable stock, so no new supplier order is needed.
Hi, Mei Chen here at 14 Alder Row. I'd like a 7kW home charger fitted on the garage wall. The Zephyr kit you described sounds right. Whatever date works for you. Mei.
Just so you know, I'm away on holiday from 6 September to 20 September and won't be reachable to sign anything off.
Your last certification filing for Volt & Vine Electrical (registration VR-0442) was received in good order. Nothing due from you until your annual renewal in March 2027.
Corvid Lighting trade price for downlight packs: 31 dollars per pack of six, from stock, next-day delivery once an order is confirmed.

Put together a restock order for 20 downlight packs from Corvid Lighting at 31 dollars a pack, 620 dollars in total. That is above the 500 dollar limit, so it needs Piotr Nowak's sign-off first. Left it unconfirmed as awaiting sign-off.

Drafted the order to Caldwell Electrical Supply for Mei Chen's Zephyr 7kW charger kit at 740 dollars. That is over the 500 dollar limit, so it needs Piotr Nowak's sign-off, and he is away until 20 September. Left the order unconfirmed as awaiting sign-off.
Booked Mei Chen's charger install at 14 Alder Row for 24 September. That follows the Caldwell delivery, which lands two working days after the kit order is confirmed once sign-off comes through.
Reminder to myself: pay the Havencore Supply invoice INV-2214 for the June cable order by 15 September.
Quick question: if the charger kit happens to arrive sooner than planned, could my install be brought forward? I'm flexible most weekdays. Mei.

Monthly plan: Odell rewire on 18 September, Chen charger install on 24 September, van restock orders as needed. Certification paperwork for the two July commercial jobs still to be filed with the registry.
Phone note: Dev Kapoor from Terncrest Bakery called about a full rewiring quote for their ovens area. Told him we'd send a quote by early October. No date or amounts agreed yet.

Team note: from today, Piotr Nowak's sign-off is only needed for supplier orders above 1500 dollars, not 500. Havencore and Caldwell have both put us on contracted rates, and the old 500 dollar limit was holding up small jobs for no good reason. Anything he already signed off stays exactly as it is.
Ridgeline Wholesale special for Volt & Vine: Zephyr 7kW charger kit supplied with pedestal mount for 895 dollars, offer valid to the end of the month. We can deliver within a week of ordering.
Chasing our side: the Zephyr 7kW kit order for your Alder Row job is still sitting with us unconfirmed. Let us know when to proceed. Jonah.
All set for the rewire on the 18th, side gate will be open from 8 in the morning. Rose.
